decisions.executionNote: Initialize both elbow-up approaches, left toward cars and right toward cameras. Plan white for cars, blue for wristbands, red for cameras; geometry estimated from RGB.
Continue overhead orientation and approach above gold car and inner camera, preserving elbow-up continuity. Grippers open.
Use wrist views to center the gold car and camera during controlled descent; depth and fingertip offset remain uncertain.
Final short descent and close on gold car and inner camera. Slight camera yaw aligns its narrow dimension; verify retention on lift.
Lift closed grippers to check retention, then carry gold car toward white and camera toward red basket with clearance.
Gold car was not retained; reopen and realign above its new position. Camera appears retained; advance slowly over red basket while slightly lowering to avoid prior IK jump.
Release retained camera over red basket and retreat from reach limit. Recenter gold car, descend slightly, close and test-lift; previous gold grasp missed.
Lift gold car closed and begin transport toward white. Approach remaining camera with right gripper rotated across its narrow dimension; verify retention and basket contents visually.
Carry visibly retained gold car above white basket with a slight lowering for reach margin. Refine remaining camera alignment from wrist view before grasp.
Release gold car into white, then retreat toward red car. Continue camera wrist-centering and descent, close cautiously; verify it on the next lift.
Test-lift second camera and begin carrying toward red basket. Align left gripper across red car's width and approach overhead; gold car is visibly in white basket.
Refine red car yaw to grip across its width and center from wrist RGB during descent. Move retained second camera fully over red basket with reach margin before releasing.
Release second camera inside red, then retreat toward right-side wristband. Center red car between left fingers, close across body and begin retention test.
Lift red car closed and carry toward white basket. Bring right arm above remaining right wristband, maintaining separation while left moves away.
Move retained red car over white basket. Descend open right gripper toward wristband, correcting its wrist-image centering before closing.
Release red car into white with gold car; retreat left toward remaining wristband. Close right gripper on centered band after a short descent and test-lift.
RGB shows red car slipped to basket front and wristband was not retained. Reopen, realign right over displaced band and left over red car, unwinding left wrist for a recovery grasp.
Use wrist views rather than uncertain head depth: shift left toward car beside basket; recenter and close right around the wristband with a small lift to check retention.
Left fingers contact basket wall; lift and rotate to grasp car across x instead. Lift right wristband closed to verify retention, then begin forward transport toward blue basket.
Right band was not retained; return open and descend farther toward its thin sidewalls. Reposition left over the leaning red car for a grasp clear of the basket wall.
Lower right fingers another 24 mm to engage wristband sidewalls, close and short test-lift. Move left toward leaning car using wrist-image offset while avoiding basket wall.
Close left fingers around the upper red car, then lift clear of the basket lip. Test right wristband retention with a straight lift before transporting; do not infer grasp from command state.
Both objects now remain between fingers after vertical lift. Raise hanging car above white lip, tilt slightly forward and advance. Carry wristband toward blue with a forward tilt for reach margin.
Advance hanging car fully past white front lip, lower and release. Bring retained wristband over blue interior, lowering and tilting forward to avoid reach limit.
Release wristband into blue and withdraw right arm. Retreat left from released car toward final wristband; verify cars settle fully inside white.
Approach final wristband from above with left, using head and wrist geometry. Right withdraws toward origin as its two cameras and first wristband are visibly in baskets.
Lower left fingers to wristband sidewalls and close, then test-lift. Continue right arm smoothly toward origin, stopping short for a final small correction.
Lift left band closed from latest observed pose after contact-limited descent; verify retention before completing transport. Finish small right-arm return-to-origin corrections.
Wristband remains between fingers after lifting. Carry it toward the left side of blue basket with a slight forward tilt and clearance, keeping right at origin.
Advance final wristband past blue basket's front lip and toward its left interior before release. Lower gradually for reach margin; right remains at origin.
Release final band over blue interior from observed pose after IK interruption. Retreat and begin smooth elbow-up return to origin; inspect settled category groups.
Band is released into blue. Replan retreat with much smaller translation and rotation near the current high-bend configuration, then gradually increase once clear.
Continue smooth left-arm return toward origin with open gripper, keeping the established elbow-up branch. All six objects appear grouped in their assigned baskets.
Complete most of remaining left return, stopping just short of origin for small final corrections. Both grippers open; baskets visually contain cars, wristbands, and cameras separately.
